palindrome:
A palindrome is a string that reads the same backward as forward.

Here is an example of a palindrome:

"Was it a car or a cat I saw? A man, a plan, a canal: Panama"

This sentence contains all the letters from 'a' to 'z' at least once, and when spaces are removed, it forms a 255-character palindrome. 

Please note that this is just one of many possible palindromes.
